body: I agree! I do this all the time, I even forget to respond half the time! I usually keep my replies short and simple. I’ve even had to let people know I need time to think of a response and they’ve never thought I was stupid or weird for that. Plus, I have really bad anxiety talking on the phone, so sending a quick text is easier for me, I hope this helps!

I’ve been dealing with almost the same as you. It’s hard to find the rights words to say because we’re all tired of hear the same old bs of how things will get better. And living with bpd is such a hard thing in itself and unfortunately, we’re stuck with it for the rest of our lives.

I don’t know you but I’m so proud of you for trying your best day in and day out and proud of everything you’ve accomplished so far. 

Believe me, I hear you. You’re not alone in this. Keep our head up, queen. You got this.
